verdict.rationale: The pack documents no data-export or portability capability for Amazon IVS, and nothing about exporting account data, channel configuration, or chat history in open formats before leaving. The only nearby items are an EventBridge event noting a stage is "being recorded to S3" and a community remark that IVS outputs m3u8 for playback. These describe recording and streaming delivery, not a documented export-and-leave capability, so they get no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
